commands.label: Parse original Pic through genuine GNU preprocessor
commands.stdout:
.do if !dPS .ds PS
.do if !dPE .ds PE
.do if !dPF .ds PF
.do if !dPY .ds PY
.lf 1 <corpus>/examples/0533_pic/hello.pic
.lf 1
.PS 0.500i 2.000i
.\" 0 -0.25 2 0.25
.\" 0.000i 0.500i 2.000i 0.000i
.nr 00 \n(.u
.nf
.nr 0x 1
\h'2.000i'
.sp -1
\D't -1.000p'\h'1.000p'
.sp -1
\h'2.000i'\v'0.500i'\D'p 0.000i -0.500i -2.000i 0.000i 0.000i 0.500i'
.sp -1
.lf 2
\h'1.000i-(\w'Hello, World!'u/2u)'\v'0.250i-(0v/2u)+0v+0.22m'Hello, World!
.sp -1
.sp 0.500i+1
.if \n(00 .fi
.br
.nr 0x 0
.lf 3
.PE
.lf 4
